security_audit.summary: The shell execution alerts are false positives caused by Markdown code fences in SKILL.md. I confirmed low-risk network egress and added a medium privacy finding for external AI processing of contact details.

remediation.issue: External AI processing of contact data
remediation.suggestion: Document consent requirements, redact unnecessary contact fields, and define retention rules before sending prompts to an external AI service.
Make the AI provider endpoint configurable and disclose outbound network access in installation guidance.

remediation.issue: Markdown examples trigger static command alerts
remediation.suggestion: Label fenced examples with safe language tags such as text or http to reduce false shell-execution matches.

content.value_statement: Teams need timely outreach that reflects each lead relationship. This skill drafts followup emails, proposals, and case study references from CRM context.
actual_capabilities: Identifies lead and prospect contacts that are ready for followup.
Builds draft emails from contact profile and interaction history.
Selects followup, proposal, case study, or general outreach content types.
Uses Claude prompt templates for B2B marketing copy generation.
Stores generated content as drafts for human review and approval.
Summarizes generation counts, draft status, and suggested next steps.
limitations: Requires accurate contact data, interaction history, and AI score fields.
Drafts should be reviewed before sending to customers or prospects.
External AI processing may require consent and data governance review.
Performance tracking depends on available email and CRM integrations.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Lead Followups
use_cases.description: Generate concise outreach drafts for leads with passed followup dates and positive engagement signals.

use_cases.title: Prepare Proposal Emails
use_cases.description: Turn high engagement records into proposal drafts with deliverables, timeline, and next step language.

use_cases.title: Create Case Study Outreach
use_cases.description: Reference relevant success stories when a prospect industry matches available proof points.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Basic Followup
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one lead after a delayed followup date.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a followup email for this lead: [name], [company], [role], [last interaction], [sentiment]. Keep it under 150 words with one clear call to action.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Proposal Draft
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a highly engaged prospect.
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a proposal email for [name] at [company]. Address [pain point], include 3 deliverables, mention the target timeline, and ask for a meeting.

prompt_templates.title: Match a Case Study
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request using industry context and proof points.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a case study reference email for [name]. Use [industry], [case study brief], [last interaction], and [desired outcome] to explain relevance.

prompt_templates.title: Batch Summarize Drafts
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request after generating several draft types.
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize generated outreach for these contacts: [contact list]. Group by content type, priority, review status, and recommended next action.

output_examples.input: A prospect asked about Q4 marketing services and has positive sentiment.
output_examples.output: A short followup email that references the Q4 interest, mentions a relevant success story, and proposes a 15-minute strategy call.

output_examples.input: A high engagement ecommerce prospect needs a marketing strategy revamp.
output_examples.output: A proposal email with tailored deliverables, a 60-day engagement frame, expected metrics, and a request to discuss next steps.

output_examples.input: A batch of qualified contacts needs draft generation and review tracking.
output_examples.output: A summary showing total drafts, content type counts, priority groups, sample contacts, and dashboard review actions.

best_practices: Review every generated draft before sending it to a contact.
Use only the contact fields needed for the current outreach goal.
Track approval, sending, and performance metrics in one workflow.
anti_patterns: Do not send generated outreach without human review.
Do not invent metrics, case studies, or customer results.
Do not include sensitive contact details that are not needed.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates followup emails, proposal emails, case study references, and generation summaries from CRM contact context.

faq.question: Does it send emails automatically?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow stores content as drafts for review and approval before sending.

faq.question: Which AI service does it use?
faq.answer: The skill describes using Claude through the Anthropic Messages API for draft generation.

faq.question: What data does it need?
faq.answer: It needs contact profile details, interaction history, engagement score, sentiment, and relevant case study information.

faq.question: Can it write proposal content?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft proposal emails with pain points, deliverables, expected outcomes, timelines, and next steps.

faq.question: What should teams check before use?
faq.answer: Teams should confirm consent, data minimization, provider approval, and human review rules before processing contact details.
